eps.ov: The devil Kanan has been cultivating humans to eat their souls... until one of them ends up as her boyfriend.
Kanan's maid, Ami, has come to check on her and snack on all the cute humans.
After catching Kyougi with his old friend, Kanan finds the courage to ask him out on a date that goes awry.
Ami arranges all kinds of ploys to try and get Kanan and Kyougi to finally kiss.
Jeanne, a saint, arrives from Heaven to protect Kyougi from devils but proves to be unintentionally seductive.
After some embarrassing events leave Kanan flustered, Kyougi skips school to take her on a beach date.
Kanan tutors Kyougi and Nadeko. Nadeko lusts for Kanan's scorn. All the girls shop for swimsuits together.
Kanan introduces Kyougi to her family, and they work on getting approval for their relationship.
Kyougi and Kanan learn how Lilim met Kanan's father, then Lilim tests their relationship with her seduction.
Jeanne comes clean. Kyougi learns about Milch's true feelings.
Kyougi and Kanan take Miel to the lakeside with them to try and earn her stamp of approval.

eps.t: Kanan and Kyougi's Trial of Love
eps.ov: Kanan and Kyougi play beach volleyball to earn Beelzebub's final stamp of approval.
